name: A planned trip counts a stay already booked after it (one day on 1 June does not fit before 90 days from 1 July)

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-01-15&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-01-15 and clears saved trips)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add) to open the trip sheet
Enter entry date 2026-07-01 (data-testid=trip-entry) and exit date 2026-09-28 (data-testid=trip-exit)
Exactly one trip row (data-testid=trip-row) shows 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-28, 90 days
In the planned trip form, enter planned entry 2026-06-01 (data-testid=planned-entry) and planned exit 2026-06-01 (data-testid=planned-exit), then click the check button (data-testid=planned-check)
The planned trip result (data-testid=planned-result) starts with 'Does not fit.'
